jobs.description: Job posting no. 20261008The GWDG is seeking aGenerative AI Developer (m/f/d)to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C) with a regular working week of 39 hours (100%). Remuneration is in accordance with the collective agreement for the German public service (federal government); depending on qualifications, the position will be grade TVöD E 13. The position is suitable for part-time work and initially limited till 31rd December 2029. The GWDG strives for long-term cooperation. If interested, there is the possibility of a doctorate.The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing center for the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society. The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the University of Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG operates the HLRN-IV system “Emmy”, one of the most powerful computers in the world.As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG offers technical support to researchers and students from various science domains using sophisticated computer codes, including earth system science, life science, and engineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. At the same time, we aim to improve our close collaboration with the German Aerospace Center (DLR), and specialized computing centers including the German Climate Computing Center (DKRZ) and the Institute for Advanced Simulation Jülich (IAS-JSC).As part of our AI Service Center for Sensitive and Critical Infrastructure (KISSKI) we have created a number of AI-based services that offer high levels of security and privacy due to being processed on our own hardware. The position will be located within the subproject “KISSKI-EvoKS” and closely collaborate with customers from SMEs and Startups to develop prototypes and workflows that lead to PoCs and Blueprints. Those customers will come predominantly from sectors with high data protection requirements.The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science (CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with an opportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing, AI, and Machine Learning.ResponsibilitiesWe have a wide range of potential responsibilities that we would like to discuss with you. Your responsibilities in our team could include, for example:- Design appropriate solutions to address customer use cases building upon our existing AI infrastructure- Support for companies in the development of AI services- Generating blueprints and whitepapers- Document solutions for internal knowledge sharing and customer handover- Representation at workshops and conferences- Integration of novel AI solutions into our AI service portfolio- Integration of novel AI solutions into the SAIA Platform (Scalable Artificial Intelligence (AI) Accelerator)Requirements- Successfully completed master's degree in computer science or related fields- Very good programming skills in a high-level programming language, primarily Python- Very good Linux skills (e.g. Bash scripting, Git, containers)- Good knowledge of software engineering (security, testing)- Good knowledge of DevOps (e.g. Gitlab, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, pytest)- Good knowledge of databases (SQLModel, SQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite)- Experience with web development (HTTP, FastAPI, HTML, JavaScript)- Basics in generative AI (e.g. LLMs, diffusion models, and use with Pytorch or Tensorflow)- Excellent analytical skills- Excellent problem-solving skills- Very good German skills (C1)- Very good English skills (C1)- Willingness to travel on businessDesirable- Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical customers- Experience with customer-facing technical roles- Basics in agile software development (e.g. Kanban, Scrum)- Experience with service-oriented user support- Exposure to HPC, scientific computing, or data-intensive domains- Experience with the use of HPC systems (e.g. SLURM)Our offer- Flexible working hours and opportunity for mobile working- A modern, diverse, and exceptional work environment with close proximity to academia and research at the intersection of several innovative technology sectors- An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center- Collaboration in a competent and committed team- Qualification and further development of your skills- Social benefits of the public sectorYour applicationHave we sparked your interest? Then please send us your application by 08.11.2026 via our online form: https://bewerbermanagement.net/r32hzThe GWDG strives for gender equity and diversity and therefore welcomes applications from any background. The GWDG strives to employ more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expressly encouraged.If you have any questions about the advertised position, please contact Prof. Dr. Julian Kunkel (e-mail: julian.kunkel@gwdg.de).Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to support the Test Means Component GR Team, Airbus is looking for aSoftware Developer for Lab Test Means (d/f/m)Within the Test Means & Digital platform domain, the 'Test Means Components' sub-department verifies and supports all instrumentation and test environments for laboratory, respectively ground test installations across all aircraft programs.You will integrate into the new and motivated Test Means Components team (across the Hamburg and Bremen sites) and serve as the Software Developer for Lab Test Means (d/f/m), taking full responsibility for ground test means components. In this role, you will be in charge of ensuring operational availability, driving new developments, and executing lifecycle governance of test means components while strictly complying with relevant quality standards and development processes. The main focus will be on Software Development according to German needs, e.g. test bricks for Ground Test Automation (GTA), Test Management System (TMS) and the Data Access Management System (DAMS):GTA: This software enables automated and remote testing. As Software Developer (d/f/m), you are responsible for developing and adapting local GTA bridges according to different test requirements based on the core GTA brick.TMS: The software drives the instrumentation, distributes parameters around between all necessary computers, executes simulation models, transmitting information between each.DAMS: This software tool records all test data from a test bench and uploads it to an archive.You will work closely with your transnational peers to foster best practices and lessons learned for a harmonized global approach. With a focus on software, you will take over responsibility for existing applications, including their registration and maintenance in ATOM (database).If you have strong experience in test instrumentation and software development, a passion for product ownership, and the motivation to manage end-to-end testing solutions in an operational aerospace environment, this job is for you!Your locationYou will be working across the Hamburg and Bremen sites.You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.Our Benefits for You- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.Your tasks and responsibilities- Product Ownership & Strategy: Act as the Product Responsible and End-to-End (E2E) referent for catalogue solutions, managing technical relationships and performance with internal and external suppliers.- Test Means Components Development: Propose and/or develop innovative test means components tailored to the specific requirements of Architects and Specialists, serving as the core Product Technical Referent for the architecture team.- Software Development: Based on GTA, develop and adapt software bricks according to specific needs. Functional testing and cybersecurity compliance are mandatory.- Operational Accountability: Ensure maximum availability and optimal utilization of all test means components. This includes executing hardware (H/W) and software (S/W) qualification tests, creating and updating Technical Sheets, and overseeing infrastructure reporting and documentation. The objective is to provide a fully validated solution for test benches.- Lifecycle & Maintenance: Lead H/W maintenance of test means, manage S/W maintenance & evolutions, and proactively perform obsolescence monitoring and mitigation.- Verification & Support: Responsible for the validation and verification of performance tests. Provide comprehensive technical support for all core and add-on functions, including hands-on integration support.- Supply Chain & Logistics: Manage the specific supply of critical components not covered under standard logistic mini-stocks (e.g., specialized test units).- Process Compliance: Ensure all new component developments fully comply with relevant processes and quality metrics defined for test means.Desired skills and qualifications- Bachelor degree in informatics or an equivalent degree programme- Strong background in the test instrumentation domain, avionics knowledge, ground test environments, or physical measurements.- Proven experience in Product Ownership, Software Development, project management, or supplier management within an engineering context.- Solid knowledge of hardware and software integration, maintenance lifecycles, and qualification testing.- Aeronautical system knowledge and familiarity with test architecture.- Advanced level of English (working language).- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage interfaces between architects, specialists, and suppliers.- Agility to multitask in a highly operational and fast-paced environment.- Problem-solving mindset and a proactive approach to obsolescence and technical challenges.- Ability and interest in teamwork across transnational sites (Hamburg, Bremen, Toulouse, and UK).- Autonomy and adaptability to integrate innovative and emerging technologies in a ground test context.- Open-mindedness, curiosity, and a positive attitude.- Occasional travel is part of the mission.Not a 100% match?
